statements.status_notes: Upsample version converter null pointer dereference is mitigated by input bounds checks backported from upstream ONNX 1.22.0 commit https://github.com/onnx/onnx/commit/cd310408165ad47c3cd7eb2b86cb5b80aa2e4fdf (GHSA-hwpq-hmq9-wj77).

External data symlink traversal is mitigated by ONNX 1.21.0 canonical path containment in checker.cc and O_NOFOLLOW opens on load paths, backported from https://github.com/onnx/onnx/commit/4755f8053928dce18a61db8fec71b69c74f786cb (GHSA-p433-9wv8-28xj).

External data hardlink attacks are rejected by ONNX 1.21.0 checker hard_link_count validation, backported from https://github.com/onnx/onnx/commit/4755f8053928dce18a61db8fec71b69c74f786cb (GHSA-cmw6-hcpp-c6jp).

Upstream ONNX 1.21.0 save_external_data TOCTOU hardening backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-49114.patch (path validation and O_NOFOLLOW atomic open in onnx/external_data_helper.py).
Upstream ONNX 1.22.0 fix backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-63632.patch (Gemm version converter rank checks in gemm_6_7.h and gemm_7_6.h).
Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-49114
Same save_external_data TOCTOU hardening as CVE-2026-49114 in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-49114.patch.
ExternalDataInfo attribute whitelist and file-size bounds validation backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-34445.patch.
onnx.hub.load no longer bypasses repo trust checks when silent=True; untrusted repos are rejected in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-28500.patch (upstream removed hub in ONNX 1.21.0).

Upstream ONNX 1.21.0 external data symlink containment backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-27489.patch (checker.cc canonical path checks) and onnx/external_data_helper.py O_NOFOLLOW open in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-34445.patch.
Debian onnx 1.17.0-3 ships upstream 1.17.0, which includes the ONNX 1.16.2 fix for download_model_with_test_data tar path traversal (Debian #1075852).
save_external_data path traversal is mitigated by ONNX 1.21.0 external data hardening backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-49114.patch and CVE-2026-27489.patch.
